name: @pdpp/reference-operations-sandbox
description: Small vendored snapshot of the pure, dependency-injected reference operations that apps/site's public sandbox/demo routes call. Mirrors the D-22 pattern used for @pdpp/reference-contract: the canonical source of these operations stays in reference-implementation/operations/ (now hosted in data-connect post-Move-B); this package is a deliberate, versioned seam apps/site depends on instead of reaching into the moved server's internals directly.
